name: skillpack-admin
description: Audit and repair this skills distribution with explicit roots, dry-run defaults, and backup-first writes.

interface.longDescription: Inventory this distribution or an explicit destination, preview adoption, detect drift, and perform a backup-first repair without deleting extra destination files. It does not operate the HRA product.
